qualityGate.reason: The generated Playwright tests compile and run without errors but have some weaknesses in selector robustness and assertion strength. The test titles do not reference their testCaseIds, and the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' appears hardcoded and static, limiting reusability. The navigation validation uses a regex but does not confirm page content. No asynchronous assertion lacks await. All generated test cases are covered except for the skipped TC-002, which is documented. The code is straightforward and maintainable but could be improved by parameterizing selectors and linking testCaseIds in the test titles.
